network.scope: Explicit Playwright BrowserContext proxy shared by browser requests, context.request and route.fetch; localhost remains direct.

browser_proof.reason: Requires actual candidate HTML full/oblique/LOD/return/reset and root visual review; no browser was run by this preparation.

geometry_proof.scope: Frozen raw numeric GLB checks, opening-ray negative controls, finite positions/normals, v2 unchanged-window invariance and production decoder raw/web oriented triangle equivalence passed. Existing override reports separately preserve target and17neighbor owner geometry; no new geometry generation was performed.

height_evidence.scope: Height parameters are conditional reconstruction estimates from separate photographed planes and uncertain 14.200634m source-front envelope; maximum modeled top is about7.035m. They are not surveyed elevations; GHSL18.602m is retained only as historical input.

identity_footprint.scope: Official XH-J-091-V address/photo chain, OSM way582319150@1 and exact Overture feature/local3733 agree; original four-point footprint is preserved. Existing audited near variant retains all 17 neighbors.

roof.scope: Source-visible gable, separate central upper/lower red-tile slopes and curved right cap are modeled and bounded native review passed. Rear roof extent/radius/depth/scale are inferred, not independently surveyed.

size_proof.scope: All four final published assets have been read and matched to frozen SHA/byte counts, each strictly below100,000,000B. Raw/web190926tri and LOD83716tri; LOD actual bounds delta is reported separately, not a silhouette or whole-native geometry proof.

source_photos.scope: Both original licensed reference photos are byte-verified; existing independent actual-view and identity reports are retained. Neither photograph is embedded in any model.

texture_mapping_qa.scope: Intentional no-photo-texture model: actual raw/web/LOD GLB image tables are empty and original licensed photos remain reference-only. Frame inset is estimated20mm; this is not optical material calibration.

uncertainty.scope: The bounded native approval and source limitations remain explicit: simplified materials/weathering/clutter, estimated hidden sides/roof/radius/metric scale and closed/simplified balcony leaves. This registration preparation does not accept HTML rendering or citywide photograph-level detail.

visible_facade_opening_grid.scope: Bounded visible-form v2 review supports left narrow/wide gable openings, angled return, recessed middle doorway and curved arched balcony opening. Raw rays verify10 openings and conditional camera checks7 photographed windows; unseen rear geometry and closed balcony leaves remain declared simplifications.

uncertainty: Hidden rear surfaces, roof depth, round-end radius and many dimensions remain estimates; this is not surveyed geometry.
Uniform wall/roof/glazing appearance is simplified and does not reproduce source weathering, clutter, trees, utility lines or measured material reflectance.
No photographs are imposed on the walls or glass solely to disguise the absence of surface detail.
The 20-building HTML release and ordinary-catalog browser test do not include Wukang129.
Limited visual approval of the three v2 corrections and visible adjacent geometry; not an optical-material or photographic pixel match.
Roof rear extents, rear openings, rounded radius and absolute scale remain conditionally inferred, not surveyed.
Uniform opaque/tinted glass, simplified roof-tile detail, balcony railing, entrance carving and service equipment do not reproduce all photograph detail.
The modeled upper balcony leaves are closed/simplified whereas both references show open leaf states; this unchanged simplification is not claimed as exact contemporary door state.
Tree/people/seasonal illumination are absent from the standalone model; their shadows and occluded details are not baked into textures.
Reference photographs are not embedded. Zero image tables are intentional, not an incomplete photo package.
No Blender, browser, rendering, production installation or navigation registration was performed for this review.
